creditAllowance.note: CORRECTED during ticket 012's live verification: the single-seat published Enterprise figure (3900) is wrong for Bas specifically — credits are pooled across multiple licenses in his enterprise (per asset 013's 'shared enterprise pool' finding), and his real pooled monthly allowance is 15000, which he stated directly. The naive 'seat type -> monthlyCredits' self-serve this schema originally specified doesn't hold whenever seats are pooled — asking seat type alone isn't enough; the actual pooled figure must be asked (or otherwise obtained) directly. Bas separately asked whether the *remaining balance* (~5000 as of 2026-08-25, since ~10000 of the 15000 is used this month) could be checked programmatically instead of asked each time: tried live with the real github-copilot OAuth token (scope read:user) against api.info-support.ghe.com's GET /users/{username}/settings/billing/ai_credit/usage (and the /usage and /usage/summary variants) — all three returned a clean 404, distinct in character from the /user/orgs call's explicit 403 'need read:org scope' response, suggesting the route isn't implemented on this GHE Data Residency tenant at all (consistent with ticket 013's earlier 404 on a different billing-adjacent endpoint on this same host) rather than a scope problem. Confirms ticket 015's finding from a different angle: no programmatic remaining-balance check is available here either. Remaining balance is NOT cached in this file since it drains continuously (ticket 015's design already excludes it) — only the corrected allowance is.
